control.description-key: Renders a Yes/No (Two Options) field as an editable Fluent UI toggle switch. Useful on forms and in editable grid/subgrid views for quickly flipping a boolean value (e.g. marking a task completed) without opening the record.

property.name: value
property.description-key: The Yes/No field to render and edit as a toggle.

property.name: onLabel
property.description-key: Label shown next to the toggle when it is on (default: Yes).

property.name: offLabel
property.description-key: Label shown next to the toggle when it is off (default: No).
